test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph gives the information on the number of students who appeared, qualified and failed in a bank PO exam (in hundreds) in different years. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0829c3a2656b5bcbffd68e41453e4f289b15ec35df6f13ba4d7a6be6f9e3ebc9.png] 

By what percentage is the average number of students who failed in the given five years more than the number of students who failed in 2017?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• The number of students appeared for the bank PO exam (in hundreds) in the years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017 are 54, 68, 120, 200, and 250 respectively.
 
• The number of students qualified for the bank PO exam (in hundreds) in the years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017 are 134, 130, 190, 230, and 280 respectively.
 
• The number of students failed for the bank PO exam (in hundreds) in the years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017 are 34, 140, 210, 280, and 160 respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage I
